brief:
The Guardian published letters from readers discussing whether celebrities like Ed Sheeran should take public positions on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Dr Richard J Goy argued that public figures should not avoid expressing political opinions, while Anna Emms defended the singer's focus on his commitment to fans rather than political commentary.

The exchange reflects broader debate over celebrity activism and the responsibilities of high-profile figures when conflicts attract global attention and public pressure for statements of solidarity or condemnation.
dek: Celebrities like Ed Sheeran should not shy away from expressing political opinions, writes Dr Richard J Goy , while Anna Emms praises the singer’s commitment to his fans.
title: Readers debate Ed Sheeran's silence on Israel-Palestine conflict
